title: Prism Observatory v1 Vocabulary
description: Closed enums from OBSERVATORY_V1_SPEC.md §3. The §3 vocabulary is the only status vocabulary permitted on the surface. Every other status-bearing word is forbidden by H1.

capability_maturity_state.description: The four capability maturity states. See OBSERVATORY_V1_SPEC.md §3.1.

distribution_state.description: The two distribution states. See OBSERVATORY_V1_SPEC.md §3.2.

allowed_maturity_distribution_pair.description: The seven allowed maturity × distribution pairs. Released + Planned is the single invalid combination. See OBSERVATORY_V1_SPEC.md §3.3.

evidence_class.description: The class of evidence supporting a claim or capability record.

failure_class.description: Closed set of failure classes for receipts. See OBSERVATORY_V1_SPEC.md §2.2 stage 11.

sanitization_remaining_verifiable.description: Closed set of relationships that may still be verified after a sanitized publication. See OBSERVATORY_V1_SPEC.md §4.8.
